reviews.title: ALMOST perfect for me
reviews.text:
This was my introduction into the world of interactive challenge alarms and boy am I glad it was. After struggling for literal decades to just get up, its helped me in so many ways become a consistent morning riser, believe that I am capable of anything, and take back control of my mornings.

1. Hardcore mode allows me to attach REAL WORLD consequences to not keeping my word to myself and skipping my alarm. I attach my debit card to an alarm and choose an amount that charges if I don’t wake up on time. I love this.

2. I can also create groups that I’m able to share with my friends and family. That way we can help hold each other accountable and I can share with others within my community.

3. I’m an Adventist Christian and I LOVE the bible verse mission that requires me to read a verse OUT LOUD in order to complete it. This not only is just really cool that it’s able to understand me and verify, but I love that it helps me start my morning off speaking words of LIFE.

With that I did say that it’s ALMOST perfect. Here’s why:

1. I’m not a fan of the smiling sun design language and desire a different skin or theme. Something more neutral would be my preference.

2. I aim to walk 20,000 daily steps, and so a step counting mission would be an incredible addition. There’s already motion-based missions like phone shaking and an outdoor touch grass one. I’ve seen other apps include this, and would love to see it here.

3. Would also love to see an increase in amount of stacked missions. It’s currently set to 3, and would love to see it increase to at least 5.

4. I already love the bible verse read-aloud mission and would love to see one that requires me to type the verse out perfectly as well.

5. Finally there have been days where I’ve been tempted to shut my phone off in order to bypass my alarm. I’ve seen this work before in sabotaging my own wake goals. With that I’d love to see, coupled with hardcore mode, some type of Phone Power Off Prevention system. If its not possible because of iOS to stop me from turning my phone off, I’m thinking penalize me for doing so.

reviews.title: 5 star/ best app and promising app ever!
reviews.text: As a 14-year-old student and heavy sleeper, I’ve really struggled to wake up for school and work lately. Apple's built-in alarms just aren't loud or consistent enough for me, so my grandma always had to wake me up. I also tend to doomscroll, which means I rarely get enough sleep. A few days ago, I saw a sponsored video on Snapchat showing how this app helps heavy sleepers. After seeing the great reviews, I downloaded it and bought the subscription. It worked perfectly the very next morning! This app is amazing, promising, and incredibly helpful for getting me up on time.
